sql: SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1
